:::{#exr-expected-error-epe}
#### The expected generalization error, covariate value by covariate value

Let $\fitproc$ be a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure),
and let the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$ of $\nobs$ observations
be independent of the new observation $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$.
Show that the [expected generalization error](#def-expected-generalization-error)
is the mean of the [expected squared prediction error at $\predvar$](#def-epe)
over the distribution of $\newpredvar$:

$$
\expgenerr{\fitproc}{\nobs} = \E{\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\newpredvar}}.
$$

:::
